name: Professional extractions / acne facial

lead: Professional extraction is manual removal of blackheads and whiteheads by an esthetician or dermatologist, often during an acne facial.
Open comedones are generally easier to remove than closed ones. Sources found no controlled trials specific to the practice.

paras: A comedo extractor applies pressure to expel the keratin and oil plug, usually after steaming or warm washing.
Picking or squeezing risks infection and scarring; hygiene and technique matter, and dermabrasion or laser can also scar.

lead: Professional comedone extraction is the manual removal of blackheads and whiteheads by an esthetician or dermatologist, usually as part of an acne facial. Practitioners use comedo extractors with attention to hygiene, typically after steaming the face or washing with warm water.[1]

A comedo is a hair follicle clogged with keratin and oil; it is open (a blackhead, dark from oxidation rather than dirt) or closed (a whitehead).[1] Dermatologists can often remove open comedones with minimal skin trauma, while closed comedones are harder to remove.[1] No controlled trial specific to esthetician extractions appears in the available sources.

paras: Salons and dermatologists use comedo extractors after steaming or warm washing.[1] Larger comedones of about 1 mm or more may be removed with surgical instruments or cauterised with a light-based device, and because isotretinoin can cause severe flare-ups of such comedones, dermatologists often remove them before and during treatment.[1]
In appearance communities professional extractions are discussed as an alternative to self-squeezing for blackheads and congestion, often as a periodic facial.

Squeezing or picking can damage the skin, raise the risk of infection and scarring, and may push infection deeper.[1] Pore strips may leave pores open and remove surface skin, and dermabrasion and laser can cause scarring.[1] Excessive washing or scrubbing can worsen comedones.[1]

lore.intro: Extractions are discussed as the professional alternative to home squeezing.[1]

claims.claim: Professional extraction is safer than squeezing at home.
